documents.summary: A short Office of Academic Integrity notice issued with the ChatGPT Edu rollout. It says there is no university-wide rule: instructors set their own policies, students must confirm what is allowed, and AI work passed off as one's own is plagiarism. It sorts AI uses by data class and tool type into pre-authorized, prohibited and case-by-case, and sets duties on data protection, human review, procurement and agentic AI. documents.summary: A February 2023 Academic Senate committee guide recommending that USC instructors set their own AI rules and tell students. It lays out two approaches, embrace and enhance or discourage and detect, with assessment techniques, sample disclosure language and a review of detection options and their weaknesses.
